fields.description: Use sandbox for Africa's Talking sandbox, or your production username when live.
fields.label: Username

fields.description: Optional registered Africa's Talking Sender ID. Leave blank to use the default short code/sender configured on the account.
fields.label: Sender ID

fields.description: Recommended for bulk sends so messages are queued by Africa's Talking.
fields.label: Use Provider Queue

fields.description: Used when users enter local numbers like 0712345678.
fields.label: Default Country Code

fields.description: Optional template used when a lease is submitted. Leave blank to use the built-in message.
fields.label: Lease SMS Template

fields.description: Optional template used when rent/invoice SMS is generated. Leave blank to use the built-in message.
fields.label: Invoice SMS Template

fields.description: Optional template used when M-Pesa payment confirmation SMS is sent. Leave blank to use the built-in message.
fields.label: Payment SMS Template

fields.description: Optional template used for rent due reminders.
fields.label: Rent Due Reminder SMS Template

fields.description: Optional template used for overdue invoice reminders.
fields.label: Overdue Invoice Reminder SMS Template

fields.description: Optional template used for lease expiry reminders.
fields.label: Lease Expiry Reminder SMS Template

fields.description: Comma-separated days before lease billing date. Example: 7,3,1. Use 0 only if you want same-day rent due reminders.
fields.label: Rent Due Reminder Days Before

fields.description: Comma-separated days after invoice due date. Example: 1,3,7,14,30.
fields.label: Overdue Invoice Reminder Days After

fields.description: Comma-separated days before lease end date. Example: 30,14,7,1. Use 0 only if you want expiry-day reminders.
fields.label: Lease Expiry Reminder Days Before

fields.description: Safety limit for total automated reminder SMS attempts per scheduler run.
fields.label: Reminder SMS Limit Per Run

fields.description: Optional secret for the Africa's Talking delivery-report callback. Add it to the callback URL as ?secret=YOUR_SECRET.
fields.label: Delivery Callback Secret

fields.description: When enabled, incoming SMS keywords like STOP and START update Tenant/Landlord Allow SMS preferences.
fields.label: Enable Inbound Keyword Processing

fields.description: Optional secret for the Africa's Talking inbound SMS callback. Add it to the callback URL as ?secret=YOUR_SECRET.
fields.label: Inbound Callback Secret

fields.description: Comma-separated keywords that opt a recipient out of campaign SMS.
fields.label: STOP / Opt-out Keywords

fields.description: Comma-separated keywords that opt a recipient back in.
fields.label: START / Opt-in Keywords

fields.description: Comma-separated informational keywords. These are logged but do not change Allow SMS.
fields.label: Help Keywords

fields.description: When enabled, the system sends a confirmation SMS after STOP, START, or HELP keywords.
fields.label: Auto-reply to Inbound Keywords

fields.default: You have been opted out of campaign SMS. Reply START to opt back in.
fields.label: Opt-out Auto-reply

fields.default: You have been opted back in to SMS updates. Reply STOP to opt out of campaign SMS.
fields.label: Opt-in Auto-reply

fields.default: Reply STOP to opt out of campaign SMS or START to opt back in.
fields.label: Help Auto-reply

fields.description: When enabled, Tenant and Landlord records with Allow SMS unchecked are skipped unless the relevant override below is enabled.
fields.label: Respect Recipient SMS Opt-out

fields.description: If enabled, lease, invoice, payment, and reminder SMS may still be sent to opted-out recipients because they are operational messages.
fields.label: Send Transactional SMS to Opted-out Recipients

fields.description: If disabled, bulk campaign recipients who opted out are marked OptedOut and skipped.
fields.label: Send Campaign SMS to Opted-out Recipients
SMS Template Help
fields.options: Templates support Jinja-style placeholders, for example {{ tenant_name }}, {{ lease_name }}, {{ amount }}, {{ due_date }}, {{ property_label }}, {{ mpesa_receipt }}.

fields.description: When enabled, the daily scheduler archives or deletes old SMS logs using the retention settings below.
fields.label: Enable SMS Cleanup

fields.description: SMS Logs older than this many days are eligible for cleanup. Minimum is 30 days.
fields.label: SMS Log Retention Days

fields.description: Inbound SMS Logs older than this many days are eligible for cleanup. Minimum is 30 days.
fields.label: Inbound Log Retention Days

fields.description: Recommended. Marks old logs as archived instead of deleting them, preserving audit history.
fields.label: Archive Instead of Delete

fields.description: When deletion is used after archiving, archived records older than this many days are eligible for deletion.
fields.label: Delete Archived Logs After Days

fields.description: Maximum records processed per cleanup run. Hard-capped at 5000.
fields.label: Cleanup Batch Size

fields.description: Recommended. Failed/rejected SMS logs remain available for debugging and compliance.
fields.label: Keep Failed SMS Logs

fields.description: Recommended. Campaign logs are retained because campaign recipient rows link to them.
fields.label: Keep Campaign SMS Logs

fields.description: Advanced. Allows delete mode to delete records that were never archived first. Keep disabled unless you are sure.
fields.label: Allow Deleting Unarchived Logs

fields.options: Recommended production setup: enable cleanup, keep Archive Instead of Delete enabled, keep failed/campaign logs, then use the manual preview endpoint before changing delete settings.
fields.label: Cleanup Help
